blocks.text: Fox & Aikins North — Park Ridge Homes Townhomes on 165A Street

parts.t: Fox & Aikins North
is a community of 42 three- and four-bedroom townhomes by Park Ridge Homes at 1871 165A Street in South Surrey, completed in 2024. Its sister phase, Fox & Aikins South, is at 1833 165A Street.
The homes are three storeys, with open-concept main floors and quartz countertops.

Ta’talu Elementary is just up 165A Street, and The Shops at Morgan Crossing and Grandview Corners are a short drive away. Fox & Aikins North is in the Ta’talu Elementary and École Earl Marriott Secondary catchments (confirm current catchment with the Surrey Schools school locator).
Ta’talu Elementary and École Earl Marriott Secondary catchments (confirm current catchment with the Surrey Schools school locator)
Park Ridge Homes has been building homes in the Fraser Valley since 1986. It also built the neighbouring Fox & Aikins South phase.
Interiors & Floor Plans

Fox & Aikins North has three- and four-bedroom floor plans over three storeys, with open-concept main floors and quartz countertops. Sizes vary by plan, so contact Jared for the square footage of a specific home.
Some plans include a den or flex space that can be used as a guest room or home office.
Strata & Ownership
Fox & Aikins North is registered as strata plan EPS9343. It is a newer strata, completed in 2024, so review the bylaws, budget and any warranty information before you buy.
Confirm what the monthly strata fees cover for the unit you're considering.

What schools serve Fox & Aikins North?

Fox & Aikins North is in the Ta’talu Elementary and École Earl Marriott Secondary catchments (confirm current catchment with the Surrey Schools school locator). Southridge School, an independent K-12 school, is at 2656 160 Street.
Are Fox & Aikins North townhomes good for families?

The three- and four-bedroom floor plans work for many families, and Ta’talu Elementary is close by. Fox & Aikins North is in the Ta’talu Elementary and École Earl Marriott Secondary catchments (confirm current catchment with the Surrey Schools school locator).
Are there homes for sale at Fox and Aikins North right now?
Listings at Fox and Aikins North come and go quickly. Check the South Surrey townhome search above, or call or text me at 604-928-1361 and I'll set up an alert for new Fox and Aikins North listings.
What should I check before buying at Fox and Aikins North?
Ask for the Form B information certificate, the strata bylaws and rules, the last two years of minutes and the depreciation report. I review these with every buyer before subjects are removed.
